package Div2_630;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class E {
    static long mod = 998244353;
    static long X, Y;
    static Map<Long, long[]> memo;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextInt();
        long m = in.nextInt();
        long p = in.nextInt();
        long q = in.nextInt();
        long x = q - p + 1;
        if (p % 2 == 0) x = x - x / 2;
        else x /= 2;
        long y = q - p + 1 - x;
        X = x;
        Y = y;
        if ((n & m) % 2 == 0) {
            memo = new HashMap<>();
            long ans = fn(x, y, n * m, 0);
            System.out.println(ans);
        } else {
            long ans = bin(x + y, n * m);
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    private static long[] computePair(long st) {
        if (st == 1) {
            return new long[]{X, Y};
        }
        if (memo.containsKey(st)) {
            return memo.get(st);
        }
        long[] res;
        if (st % 2 == 1) {
            long[] prev = computePair(st - 1);
            long a = prev[0];
            long b = prev[1];
            res = new long[]{
                (X * a + Y * b) % mod,
                (X * b + Y * a) % mod
            };
        } else {
            long[] half = computePair(st / 2);
            long ch = half[0];
            long nch = half[1];
            res = new long[]{
                (ch * ch + nch * nch) % mod,
                (2 * ch * nch) % mod
            };
        }
        memo.put(st, res);
        return res;
    }

    private static long fn(long x, long y, long st, int type) {
        long[] pair = computePair(st);
        return type == 0 ? pair[0] : pair[1];
    }

    private static long bin(long x, long st) {
        long res = 1;
        while (st > 0) {
            if ((st & 1) == 1) res = (res * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            st >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}

package Div2_630;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Stack;

public class E {
    static long mod = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextInt();
        long m = in.nextInt();
        long p = in.nextInt();
        long q = in.nextInt();
        long x = q - p + 1;
        if (p % 2 == 0) x = x - x / 2;
        else x /= 2;
        long y = q - p + 1 - x;
        if ((n & m) % 2 == 0) {
            long ans = fn(x, y, n * m, 0);
            System.out.println(ans);
        } else {
            long ans = bin(x + y, n * m);
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    private static long fn(long x, long y, long st, int type) {
        Stack<long[]> stack = new Stack<>();
        stack.push(new long[]{st, type, 0, 0});
        long result = 0;
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            long[] frame = stack.peek();
            long curSt = frame[0];
            int curType = (int) frame[1];
            int stage = (int) frame[2];
            if (curSt == 1) {
                result = (curType == 0) ? x : y;
                stack.pop();
                continue;
            }
            if (curSt % 2 == 1) {
                if (stage == 0) {
                    frame[2] = 1;
                    stack.push(new long[]{curSt - 1, curType, 0, 0});
                } else if (stage == 1) {
                    long first = result;
                    frame[2] = 2;
                    stack.push(new long[]{curSt - 1, (curType + 1) % 2, 0, 0});
                } else {
                    long first = frame[3];
                    long second = result;
                    result = (x * first + y * second) % mod;
                    stack.pop();
                }
            } else {
                if (stage == 0) {
                    frame[2] = 1;
                    stack.push(new long[]{curSt / 2, 0, 0, 0});
                } else if (stage == 1) {
                    long ch = result;
                    frame[3] = ch;
                    frame[2] = 2;
                    stack.push(new long[]{curSt / 2, 1, 0, 0});
                } else {
                    long ch = frame[3];
                    long nch = result;
                    if (curType == 0) {
                        result = (ch * ch + nch * nch) % mod;
                    } else {
                        result = (2 * ch * nch) % mod;
                    }
                    stack.pop();
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static long bin(long x, long st) {
        long res = 1;
        while (st > 0) {
            if ((st & 1) == 1) res = (res * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            st >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
